updates.old: Hume's Empathic Voice Interface (EVI) — voice agent platform with vocal-affect understanding. Hume raised $50M Series B Mar-2024 (EQT). Distinguished from pure LLM voice agents by emotion/prosody modelling; uses Hume's proprietary speech-prosody models.
updates.new: Hume's Empathic Voice Interface (EVI) — voice agent platform with vocal-affect understanding, using Hume's proprietary speech-prosody models. Hume will shut down the EVI and TTS APIs on 2026-11-13 (announced in its docs). Hume raised $50M Series B Mar-2024 (EQT).
